VTS Scoring Log

Precision Peptide Co

precisionpeptideco.com · Est. Late 2023 · Precision Peptide Co LLC · Scored August 2026

Precision Peptide Co operates a publicly accessible site and states that lab results are displayed on each product sales page - a meaningful distinction from vendors who provide COAs only on request. Testing is described as conducted by "reputable USA labs," but no laboratory is named by facility name, address, or credentials. The operating entity is Precision Peptide Co LLC. Free Priority USPS shipping applies on orders over $100. The return policy does not accept returns due to quality control standards and product fragility, though resolution is offered for incorrect, missing, or damaged items. Without a named lab, the testing scope and completeness cannot be independently verified, and COA authenticity cannot be confirmed through a lab's own records.

44 /100
Limited
Claims COAs on every product page with US lab testing. No lab named. No-return policy. Named entity Precision Peptide Co LLC. Accessible public site with product-page COA accessibility - limited by inability to verify lab credentials or cross-check documentation.

Community feedback volume is limited. Peptide Critic documents a small number of reviews. No significant patterns of shipping failures, quality complaints, or product consistency issues identified in publicly available sources at time of scoring.
Scoring Notes
Product-page COA model is the primary strength
Displaying lab results on every product page - rather than requiring a COA request - is a meaningful accessibility commitment and places this vendor above request-only models. The limitation is that without a named lab, a researcher viewing those COAs cannot independently confirm they were produced by a real, accredited facility or cross-check the results through the lab's own records. A named lab with verifiable credentials would move this score into the Moderate band.
No-return policy with no physical address is a policy gap
A vendor that does not accept returns and also does not publish a physical address or phone number gives researchers limited recourse if a quality issue is not resolved through the stated email process. The combination of these two factors limits the Policy Transparency score more than either would individually.
Sources: precisionpeptideco.com (homepage, why-precision-peptides/, refunds-returns/, shipping-info/, terms/, faq/). VTS measures process transparency from publicly available materials only.
